_about: Frozen listing phone numbers, keyed by id (Dean, 27 Oct 2026). Automatic jobs must not change them; a different number is held for Dean. Hand edits belong in this file, in a reviewed PR. Regenerate: python3 scripts/phone_baseline.py generate. After the reviewed batch 2 combine (PRs 207 and 208), run generate again so the reviewed council-number changes are the new freeze and are not held (Perth, Redbridge, Runnymede, Trafford, Kingston, Birmingham, Bolton). Compare with batch 2: python3 scripts/phone_baseline.py compare origin/batch-2a-listings origin/batch-2b-content.
